proof_decision.trust_question: Can evaluation routing admit provider identity and lifecycle evidence only through the host-owned trust boundary while preserving quiet non-match and selective due-action behavior?
proof_decision.narrowest_evidence: Focused evaluation matching, quiet non-match, due-action projection, host-owned provider admission, forged-provider rejection, report compilation, and specialist-authority fixtures.
proof_decision.prune_or_replacement_condition: Replace only when the evaluation registry generates equivalent provider-trust, lifecycle, matching, and reporting conformance cases.
proof_decision.residual_risk: Compiled due reports remain local evidence; external delivery sinks, receipts, retries, and migrations are not implied by report compilation.
